rationale: Kitchen fire caused by accidental grease flare-up resulted in direct damage to the policyholder's own property (cabinets, ceiling, walls), fitting the property_damage claim type.
claim_summary: Kitchen fire from grease flare-up with charred cabinets and smoke damage to ceiling and walls; no injuries; medium severity claim under $250,000 coverage limit.

case_facts.description: Grease fire on stove; charred cabinets above stove; smoke damage on ceiling and walls
case_facts.cause: Grease flare-up while cooking; fire extinguished by claimant

rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own property from a burst pipe in their own plumbing system is straightforward property damage coverage.
claim_summary: Basement flood from burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink; extensive damage to hardwood floor, drywall, and stored items; high severity with estimated loss exceeding $10,000.

case_facts.description: two inches of water across entire basement; hardwood floor buckled; drywall soaked up to one foot; stored boxes ruined
case_facts.discovery: claimant discovered upon return from work trip
case_facts.cause: supply line burst under upstairs bathroom sink; ran for approximately two days

rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's roof structure is straightforward property damage to the insured dwelling.
claim_summary: Wind-blown shingles from back porch overhang; estimated $400 repair cost with no secondary damage or injuries.

case_facts.incident_type: Wind damage - shingles blown off overhang
case_facts.damage_description: Approximately four shingles blown off; no water intrusion or secondary damage
